string.name: m_prompt_intro
string.value: Please help me set up HermesPaw phone access on this machine (the one running the Hermes gateway). Goal:

string.name: m_prompt_step1
string.value: 1. Use the default profile of the local Hermes gateway; if it does not exist, report and stop;

string.name: m_prompt_step2
string.value: 2. That profile's API server must be ready: enabled, listening on the office network (not loopback), holding a long-lived key; if already ready, verify and skip;

string.name: m_prompt_step3
string.value: 3. Generate the HermesPaw pairing QR code (a hermespaw:// setup string, single tier), saved to /tmp/hermespaw-qr.png;

string.name: m_prompt_step4
string.value: 4. Send me that image file; if this channel cannot send images, paste the hermespaw:// string into the chat instead (it contains a long-lived key — send it only over a trusted channel and do not forward it);

string.name: m_prompt_step5
string.value: 5. If a pre-check fails midway (e.g. API server unreachable, no key), report the cause and the fix instead of generating a code; if a gateway restart is needed, give me the command and wait for me;

string.name: m_prompt_step6
string.value: 6. After I finish scanning, remind me to delete /tmp/hermespaw-qr.png.
